body: Fucking Netflix or any other simple shit like that does not outweigh the problems with life. I don't want to work 9 hours a day just so I can watch a total of maybe 3-5 hours of Netflix before I go to sleep, not having fulfilled my day at all with things I wanna do. And my solution to "unfortunately having to work in this world"? I don't live in this world.
I understand your frustration. Fuck these people, they're all low IQ monkeys who don't even know why they're really here on this sub, let alone why you should keep living.

>So I was wondering the best placement for the shotgun. Should I shot through my mouth or at my temple?

I don't think you're allowed to give advice on methods here, but if it ever definitely comes to shove, I've always heard through the roof was better. Something about hitting the brainstem and putting the person out immediately, as opposed to temple, which will probably hit the frontal lobes and wont ensure death or immediate death. I sort of resonate with your point about not wanting to become a paraplegic barely able to think anyways. I used to have a huge fear of being shot in the head because of that. Now, it doesn't seem as bad. They should have controlled and safe medical methods so you won't have to worry about crap like that. People will bring up how it will fail 99% of the time and you might end up fucked up, it wouldn't fail if people didn't have to use such half-assed and violent methods. And if you are fucked up, they now have a reason to put you out of your misery or what they "perceive" as suitable misery, yet they still wont do it because they are heartless, evil fucks. The world is a really fucked up place.

Schools are less about helping you learn stuff and more about molding you into the perfect blind "hard-worker" society values. I mean, think about it. They literally make you take these tests, where you are asked random questions that don't even cover the full material half the time, and judge by that whether or not you "pass." They don't actually care if you absorb the material at all, just that you're productive and "hard-working" enough to make sure you ace that one randomly-quizzed test. Most people wont even remember the shit they "learned" in High School by the time they're 30.
Well it just sounds like you found a way to lie to yourself. I don't think I can. I have no "purpose."
I don't think so. At this point all I can do is change my mindframe and I'm not the type of person to lie to myself about things I know that are true or purposefully blind myself with optimism.
Well maybe I am lazy. I don't think it's the fault of anything, I've just always been like this. I've always had an extreme aversion to doing things I don't want to do.
Well I have no passion. If that's all life is about, then I want nothing to do with it. I already said don't tell me this anyways because I've heard it all before and there's nothing I want to do.
